race.title: Coral Sir Peter O'Sullevan Memorial Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: This looks ultra competitive with the progressive NORN IRON topping the shortlist having prevented a Willie Mullins 1-2-3 when second at the Punchestown Festival. This test could be ideal for Jipcot , while Venetia Williams saddles a couple of interesting runners in Demnat and Holetown . NORN IRON (IRE) JIPCOT (FR) DEMNAT (FR)
race.bettingForecast: Leader In The Park (4/1), Knight Of Allen (9/2), Barlovento (6/1), El Capitaine (7/1), Norn Iron (10/1), Jipcot (12/1), Kdeux Saint Fray (14/1), King's Threshold (14/1), Go West (16/1), Demnat (20/1), Moon D'orange (20/1), Royal Jewel (20/1), Down Memory Lane (25/1), Chuggy (25/1), Holetown (25/1), Sheldon (25/1), Neon Moon (33/1), Eyed (33/1)
